text:
maya: Quick check — we're doing a mini-wave launch next Tue 10am PT. Need X + LinkedIn thread scheduling, assets, and engagement owners. Can we confirm windows and who owns first 48h followups? cc @lena @tom

lena: I can own X posting + replies first 24h. What versions of the hero do we have? Need 1200x675 + 1:1 for clip.

tom: I'll handle LinkedIn threads and outreach to partners. Is the benchmark narrative finalized? I want 3 bullet points: cost/perf, dev DX, customer success snippet.

maya: Yes — draft here: https://drive.google.com/xxx — bullets: 1) predictable latency; 2) dedicated vs hosted choice; 3) case study blurb (Acme). Please shorten for LI.

cj: Assets checklist: hero 1200x675 (jpg), square 1080 (png), 30s clip (mp4 720p), 15s teaser, CTA overlay with 'Register' + webinar link. Also need alt text and short caption variants.

katie: Webinar registration link?

social-bot: New registration URL -> https://redwood.ai/events/miniwave?utm_source=social

lena: For X thread: plan 3 tweets: teaser -> hook w/ stat -> CTA. Suggest posting times: 10:00am PT (launch), 3:00pm PT (nudge), next day 9:00am PT (reminder).

maya: CTA and UTM: ?utm_campaign=miniwave_launch&utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social. For LinkedIn replace source=linkedin. Make sure partner tags and handles listed in doc.

tom: I'll convert bullets to LI-friendly post. Draft in thread:

tom: "Shipping inference that scales — predictable latency, cost controls, and unified deploys. Join our webinar to see benchmarks and live Q&A. Register -> https://redwood.ai/events/miniwave?utm_campaign=miniwave_launch&utm_source=linkedin"

lena: looks good. Add a short stat: "2–5x cost reduction in kv-caching workloads"? need approval.

maya: Approved. CJ, can you render clip with overlay stat + CTA? Need it by Fri EOD.

cj: On it. Will also export 15s vertical for stories.

katie: Who's handling first responses on LinkedIn comments? I can do product Qs, lena handles support-type replies, tom handles partner mentions.

maya: Perfect. Also set up a simple playbook for followups: 1) collect 10 high-engagement replies, 2) route to AE for demo leads, 3) DM top replies. I'll add to doc.

lena: one more — can we pin a short FAQ comment on X with webinar time + timezone conversions? saves repetitive replies.

maya: yes — please pin. Also add RSVP reminder DM to registrants 24h before.

social-bot: reminder: submit final assets to #marketing-assets by 2026-04-04T23:59Z

cj: submitted mockups to drive: https://drive.google.com/yyy — feedback welcome.

katie: thumbs up from legal on claims and stat. We can run backup variant without the stat if needed.

maya: cool. Final checklist: assets (hero/video/alt), captions (X, LI), UTMs, schedule, owners (lena, tom, katie, cj), playbook for 48h. If anyone sees gaps say now.

tom: I'll post LI draft in doc for quick signoff.

lena: :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks all! :rocket:
